build_s2t_transformer_model: build a speech-to-text transformer model using S2TTransformerModel.build_model with args and task
build_s2t_transformer_encoder: build a speech-to-text transformer encoder using S2TTransformerEncoder with convolutional subsampling and transformer layers
create_conv1d_subsampler: create a Conv1dSubsampler module to downsample audio features using stacked 1D convolutions with GLU activation
configure_s2t_architecture: configure an s2t_transformer architecture variant like s2t_transformer_s or s2t_transformer_l with preset hyperparameters
load_pretrained_encoder: load a pretrained encoder into S2TTransformerModel using load_pretrained_encoder_from checkpoint path
